name: International Aid Charity
mission: International Aid Charity (IAC) provides emergency and ongoing aid relief, education, orphan sponsorship and social support services to marginalized peoples throughout the world. Our donors and volunteers work directly with communities to offer both physical and emotional health through education, housing and vocational training for orphans and widows, sports and creative arts programs. IAC offers a foundation of hope and resources upon which those in need can build and thrive.
theoryOfChange: International Aid Charity (IAC) outlines its approach to creating lasting change and impact on its 'Smart Giving & Sustainability' page. The charity emphasizes 'strategic philanthropy that ensures your generosity creates lasting change' and states that 'every project is designed to create dignity, self-reliance, and hope for generations to come.' They focus on 'sustainable solutions that empower individuals and strengthen communities' to 'transform compassion into lasting impact.' This framework describes their philosophy and the intended long-term effects of their programs, aligning with the principles of an impact framework.

strengths_deep_dive: International Aid Charity demonstrates strong operational efficiency by directing <cite id="3">87.8% of expenses to program services in FY2024</cite>. This exceeds the 75% industry benchmark, ensuring that most contributions fund frontline humanitarian programs. The organization maintains strong trust signals, evidenced by <cite id="1">an overall score of 87.5/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>. Furthermore, its <cite id="2">zakat-eligible programs</cite> serve vulnerable populations across conflict-affected regions, meeting clear faith-based donor standards.
rich_narrative.summary: International Aid Charity provides humanitarian relief, refugee education, and orphan sponsorship. Operating primarily in areas like Jordan, Syria, and Gaza, the organization reported <cite id="3">$851,150 in total revenue in FY2024</cite>. The organization allocated <cite id="3">87.8% of expenses to program activities in FY2024</cite>, delivering direct services at a low cost per beneficiary. International Aid Charity maintains <cite id="2">explicit zakat-eligible programs</cite> tailored for Muslim donors, directing aid to poor and needy communities. The organization earned <cite id="1">an overall score of 87.5/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>. However, revenue dropped from $1,481,959 in FY2023 to $851,150 in FY2024, reflecting a 43% single-year decline.
